# v1.9.0 — Add manual items to the global Nabava list

- Added a global To-Do list for manually entered shopping items alongside the aggregated items from every board.
- Added `POST`, `PATCH`, and `DELETE /api/nabava/items` for manual items. These routes deliberately remain isolated from board-owned entries; attempts to edit/delete the wrong item type return not found.
- Nabava responses identify manual items with a null board ID and no board name.
- Added web and mobile entry forms and a **Ručno dodano** marker; tick/delete actions route to the correct global or board API.
- Preserved real-time updates by broadcasting Nabava sync events for mutations.

## Verification

- End-to-end API/browser checks covered add, tick, delete, type isolation, and unauthenticated access; Flutter 3.24.3 analysis and all 7 Flutter tests passed.
